title: tab used for indentation
notes: Fixed (spec docs/error-reporting/specs/E-BOUNDARY.md). PyYAML's own text was already good; all it needed was to not be the 58th line of a traceback. The tab is rendered as one space in the excerpt so the caret column equals the source column with no tab-stop arithmetic, which makes the tab invisible by construction -- hence the headline and the caret label both name it in words.
